candidate.devices: Wii U, Aroma (the 2.4.3 supporter preview 2 files, byte for byte). Tiramisu: not tested, no device.
candidate.notes: Maintainer-reported console tests on Aroma: install and launch, update from the earlier build through the developer server, playback, seeking, audio and subtitles, navigation and the GamePad views, settings and subscriptions after a restart. Public source is the supporter source plus the site and release tooling. Tiramisu is untested and the release notes say so; no supporter feedback is on record, so that check is waived by the maintainer's decision to release.

install_tiramisu.waived: No Tiramisu device to test on; the release notes say it is untested

preview_feedback.waived: No supporter feedback is on record; the maintainer chose to release after the preview week
